key_decisions: SSH IS THE PRIMARY CHANNEL NOW. Server-side work needs no user click; only GUI actions (launch, Generate, Finder extract) need DeskIn. This is the single biggest change from the June Mac session.

scp DOES NOT QUARANTINE, so the quarantine/launch test had to have its precondition manufactured or it would have been vacuous - a clean launch on a box where the blocking condition cannot occur looks exactly like a fix working. Same trap the release checklist warns about for Windows SAC.
SDXL Realistic chosen over any depth-capable alternative because it is the only one that is BOTH sizeTier low and depth-capable, so it covers two checklist items on a billed machine for one download.
THE MACOS BOX HAD NO XCODE CLT despite the rental advertising it. Expect this on any fresh Mac - it is now MPI-416.

THE MACOS TORCH IS A NIGHTLY BY DESIGN: comfy install --m-series resolves against download.pytorch.org/whl/nightly/cpu, and engine.js:394 documents why --fast-deps is excluded there. Installed 2.14.0.dev20260730. NOT a bug, but it is UNPINNED - every Mac user gets whatever nightly exists on the day they install. Worth raising after the run; it originates in comfy-cli, not our code, and predates 1.3.0.

The @cubric/connector dangling symlink is HARMLESS to the app - all three consumers use dynamic import inside try/catch, and brokerBoot.js explicitly returns null with an SDK-not-installed comment. The cost is that our own documented xattr command errors for every Mac user.
